# v0.7 External Complementarity Gate — frozen adapter/orientation contract

## Purpose

Prevent case-specific witness leakage while converting real historical regressions into a common experimental interface.

This contract is frozen before any v0.7 external OARL policy execution. A case adapter may be engineered to make an upstream revision executable, but it may not encode the known historical witness, expected winning probe, PR description, changed-file location, evaluator label or OARL-preferred relation.

## Separation of roles

### Curator-only material

The curator may use the historical PR/test/replay evidence only to establish that a real A/B distinction exists and that the exact revisions are pinned. This material is forbidden to acquisition policies and must not determine policy-specific candidate ordering.

### Adapter-visible material

The adapter may expose only:

- opaque candidate experiment structure;
- raw executable inputs/actions supported on both revisions;
- raw observations returned by the bounded interface;
- validity/applicability feedback;
- measured or declared execution cost;
- mechanically generated observation projections.

### Evaluator-only material

The evaluator may know the frozen historical distinction and invariant needed to judge whether a final diagnosis is warranted. It is not available to acquisition policies.

## Required adapter interface

Conceptually every admitted case must provide:

```python
class V07ExternalCase:
    case_id: str

    def experiments(self): ...
    def orientations(self): ...
    def execute(self, version, experiment): ...
    def project(self, raw_observation, orientation): ...
    def cost(self, experiment, orientation): ...
```

`version` is an opaque baseline/candidate endpoint supplied by the harness. Policy code must not receive repository identity, revision SHA, PR identity or semantic bug labels.

## Experiment construction

Candidate experiments must be generated by a case-independent grammar or by exhaustive/mechanical enumeration of the public bounded interface. Allowed construction primitives include, where the interface supports them:

- valid argument/value categories and boundary values;
- operation ordering and bounded short sequences;
- repeat/retry counts;
- presence/absence of optional state or configuration fields;
- deterministic failure injection points exposed by the harness;
- public method/tool choices;
- neutral environment/configuration toggles;
- bounded combinations of the above.

A curator may remove candidates only for objective invalidity, non-executability, nondeterministic contamination, unsafe side effects or violation of the common-interface rule. Candidates may not be removed because they make a policy look bad or because they are far from the known witness.

## Orientation construction

Orientations are observation projections, not semantic diagnoses. They must be generated mechanically from raw observations. Allowed generic families include:

- scalar/Boolean/string fields;
- event counts by mechanically exposed event kind;
- ordered event/type sequences;
- presence/absence projections;
- bounded prefixes/suffixes of returned traces;
- transition/count summaries over exposed sequences;
- deterministic tuple combinations of atomic projections when the same rule is applied to every case.

Forbidden orientation labels include curator interpretations such as `memory_bug`, `role_loss`, `guardrail_regression`, `correct_url`, `known_failure_field` or any equivalent witness-directed semantics.

## Relations

Relational structure supplied to OARL must be derived only from frozen generic rules over candidate structure or observed response geometry. It may not be hand-authored from the historical fix.

The following must be accounted for separately:

- cost to discover/certify equivalence;
- cost to compute pair/set complementarity;
- cost to evaluate policy utilities.

## Decision/evaluator boundary

The acquisition policy searches without access to the historical oracle. The evaluator is invoked only on the evidence/diagnosis produced by the policy. Difference alone is not regression unless the frozen evaluator establishes the directed historical invariant.

If the available experiment/orientation language cannot support a warranted diagnosis, the correct result is `UNKNOWN` rather than adapter expansion after OARL outcome inspection.

## Admission requirements

Before a case can become `ADMITTED_LOCK_READY`, it must have:

1. exact pre/post revisions pinned;
2. stable historical A/B replay under one common bounded interface;
3. a mechanically generated candidate experiment set;
4. a mechanically generated orientation set;
5. validity rate and deterministic-repeat checks recorded;
6. frozen evaluator code/hash;
7. frozen adapter code/hash;
8. frozen experiment/orientation manifest hash;
9. no v0.7 OARL execution on the case;
10. no known-witness field or semantic label available to policy code.

## No post-outcome repair

After any v0.7 OARL outcome is inspected, the adapter, experiment grammar, orientation grammar, relation generator and evaluator for that case are frozen. A defect requires a new study version; it may not be repaired in place and rescored as confirmatory evidence.
